description: A bearded man with dark curly hair and a slight smile is seated while playing a drum kit. He holds wooden drumsticks in both hands, striking a snare drum and cymbal, with warm sunlight streaming from a high window behind him.
title: Bearded Drummer in Studio
prompt: A bearded man with dark wavy hair and a full beard, wearing a dark grey hoodie and ripped black jeans, is captured mid-performance playing a drum kit. He smiles slightly while looking down at the drums, right hand striking a brass cymbal with a drumstick, left hand on a snare. Warm dramatic sunlight pours from a high industrial window in the upper left, creating strong god rays and lens flare. String lights hang in the background against a textured brick wall. Cinematic moody lighting, realistic photographic style, detailed drum hardware and white drum heads visible, shallow depth of field, warm golden tones mixed with cooler shadows.
